benchmarks.stat: 44% of CFOs use genAI in five-plus finance use cases (up from 7% in 2024)
benchmarks.claim: GenAI adoption in finance has scaled roughly six-fold in a year, but broad multi-use deployment is still a minority.

benchmarks.stat: 20-30% less time spent crunching data where genAI is robustly adopted
benchmarks.claim: In finance functions with mature genAI use, professionals reclaim a fifth to a third of data-processing time for business-partnering.
benchmarks.source_type: McKinsey (How finance teams are putting AI to work, 2025)

benchmarks.stat: Spreadsheet consolidation consumes 20-30% of the planning cycle
benchmarks.claim: A fifth to a third of planning-cycle effort is manual data consolidation that AI can compress.
benchmarks.source_type: McKinsey (How finance teams are putting AI to work, 2025)

benchmarks.stat: 59% of finance leaders use AI in 2025 (vs 58% in 2024, 37% in 2023)
benchmarks.claim: Finance AI adoption has plateaued after a sharp 2023-24 jump, signalling a stalled scaling curve.

benchmarks.stat: 66% of AI-adopting finance teams cite greater efficiency/productivity as the top benefit
benchmarks.claim: Where finance has deployed AI, two-thirds report efficiency and productivity as the leading realised benefit.

benchmarks.stat: 63% of finance organisations say AI implementation was slower than expected in 2025
benchmarks.claim: Nearly two-thirds of finance functions are hitting an execution gap between AI ambition and delivery.

benchmarks.stat: CFOs with strategic AI deployment to add ~10 margin points of growth by 2029
benchmarks.claim: Gartner forecasts a 10-point margin advantage for CFOs who manage AI as a portfolio rather than isolated pilots.

benchmarks.stat: Median reported ROI from AI in finance is just 10%, vs a ~20% target
benchmarks.claim: The first systematic study to quantify finance-AI ROI finds returns running at half the level leaders aim for.
benchmarks.source_type: BCG Center for CFO Excellence (280+ finance execs, Mar 2025)

benchmarks.stat: Active AI use in finance rose to 75% in 2025, up from 30% in 2024
benchmarks.claim: Finance AI usage more than doubled year-on-year as governance matured, per a 1,013-leader global survey.

benchmarks.stat: 64% of AI-using finance orgs report improved forecast accuracy
benchmarks.claim: Nearly two-thirds see measurable forecast-accuracy gains, alongside 70% decision quality and 71% decision speed.

benchmarks.stat: 71% of finance leaders say AI is meeting or exceeding ROI expectations
benchmarks.claim: Just over seven in ten report AI investment paying back as expected or better, concentrated in planning/forecasting.

benchmarks.stat: HPE cut its financial reporting cycle by ~40% using an agentic AI tool
benchmarks.claim: A real-world agentic AI deployment compressed the reporting close by about 40% and sharpened performance discussions.
benchmarks.source_type: Deloitte (CFO Guide to Tech Trends 2026 / HPE case)

benchmarks.stat: 87% of CFOs expect AI to be very/extremely important to finance in 2026; 54% prioritise AI agents
benchmarks.claim: Nearly nine in ten CFOs deem AI critical to finance operations, and a majority are prioritising agentic AI.

benchmarks.stat: Only 23% of FP&A practitioners currently use AI; 53% use it in no FP&A process
benchmarks.claim: Despite the hype, FP&A adoption remains low, with only ~10% using AI for forecasting or data analytics.
benchmarks.source_type: AFP (2025 FP&A Benchmarking Survey) / FP&A Trends Survey

benchmarks.stat: 61% cite unreliable data and 60% inaccessible data as top barriers to FP&A tech success
benchmarks.claim: Poor data quality and accessibility, not tooling, are the leading blockers to AI value in FP&A.

benchmarks.stat: Leading AP platforms deliver 3.5x productivity, 60% touchless invoices, 59% faster cycle times
benchmarks.claim: Best-in-class AI-enabled transaction processing shows 3.5x productivity gains, evidencing scale where use cases are mature.
benchmarks.source_type: Hackett Group (AP Digital World Class Matrix, Nov 2025)
